  unfold ratSqrt
  rw [← mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_right (a := (prec ^ 2 : ℚ)) (by positivity)]
  rw [← mul_pow, add_mul]
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀, div_mul_cancel₀]

    exact lt_succ_sqrt' (x * prec ^ 2)
  all_goals norm_cast; positivity
